name: net-pimc
author: Essam
description: Rung 2: PIMC search that only considers the cards a net trained on PIMC-100 rates highest, with the saved effort spent on deeper search. HeuristicBot bidding, like PIMC.
method: Heuristic bids: count tricks the hand should win
card net (copies PIMC-100) keeps its top 3 cards
each kept card: Heuristic plays the round out on every hand
